scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

san-francisco-skyline-alice-s-and-pacifi.story: A one-way ride of 532 km, Belmont to Alamo - roughly 9 h 40 in the saddle. On the way it passes Alice’s Restaurant rider stop, Pescadero coast view, Half Moon Bay water stop and Skyline Boulevard ridge. near Stanford is the high point. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
